components.basis: The front-matter promise (inherited-00533-00602.tex:14-16) names countable-language versions of the completeness and omitting-types theorems. Completeness: cor:fol-completeness-countable (inherited-04713-04920.tex:48-63) states choice-free completeness for countable signatures, finite included, and back-references the promise. Its proof (64-118) identifies the two points where choice enters lem:henkin-lindenbaum, replaces them with an explicit injection-based coding and least-number enumeration, reduces the cardinal bookkeeping to finite counting, and checks that no other ingredient uses choice. Omitting types: thm:omitting-types (inherited-06792-06845.tex:24-31) is stated for a countable signature with no AC hypothesis and a status pointer to annex:p3.vaught.partial-omission (handbook/annex/p03/n-a-003-01.tex:1106). All three files are on the active route.

components.gap: The clause requires that AC be hypothesized only where needed, and it is not. thm:fol-lk-completeness (inherited-04713-04920.tex:120-131), a completeness theorem of the same section, assumes the Axiom of Choice for every signature. That includes countable signatures, where cor:fol-completeness-countable already supplies, without choice, the ND completeness that step 2 (line 165) consumes. No countable choice-free version or scoped AC hypothesis is stated for it. thm:fol-completeness (lines 4-14) likewise keeps an AC hypothesis for all signatures; its countable case is discharged only by the separate corollary. The front-matter-promise half of the clause is met: both promises resolve to labeled results.
